verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that every run is kept on the phone, can be replayed step by step, and can be exported as a trace of screenshots, actions and annotations. That is replay and trace export, not reporting of per-run metrics. Nothing documents success status, duration, token counts or dollar cost for a run, so the applicable axis has no evidenced support.

support.subject: As an operator, per-run metrics (success, duration, token or dollar cost) are reported, so I can compare runs
